scope: Actual installed Hermes Runs API, actual managed profile/worker/plugin, actual Voice private Unix tool handler and TaskManager/TaskStore, with a synthetic loopback inference server and synthetic router lifetime facade. This does not use the production provider/router process or a live account.

isolation.network: Separate network namespace verified different from outer namespace; only lo interface present. Fake inference binds 127.0.0.1.
isolation.filesystem: Host filesystem read-only; host /home, /tmp and /run/user hidden except read-only source checkout and one owned writable temporary directory.
isolation.credentials: Only synthetic inference token and freshly generated temporary local IPC tokens. Credential lookup object throws on use; no real account/keyring values read.
isolation.audio: Audio/conversation/consumer-executor factories throw if invoked; no Voice conversation or microphone started.
isolation.processes: Real AssistantRuntime owns spawned Hermes process groups; each case verified released client, exited child, absent process group and empty synthetic router owners. Temporary profiles/workspaces removed on outer exit.

cases.command_scope: Harmless write to one marker inside the owned temporary directory only; never authorized as a managed capability.
cases.actual_rejection: Tool 'terminal' does not exist. Available tools: maslow_create_note, maslow_list_documents, maslow_read_document

payload_compatibility.result: All six observed synthetic inference request bodies passed assertTextRequest imported from actual applied upstream policy.ts; source bytes matched reviewed free_ai/router/src/maslow/policy.ts.
payload_compatibility.auxiliary_output_limit_note: Auxiliary request omitted max_tokens; production createMaslowApp supplies 2048 when both output limits are absent. This fixture checked request-body acceptance, not actual provider dispatch.

metadata_probes.handling: All returned local HTTP404. No alternate provider or external network was available. These are observed Hermes metadata probes, not inference requests or accepted provider catalog proof.

helper_iteration_failures: Initial negative assertion omitted the installed wording does not exist; exact captured rejection and source name gate showed a helper expectation error, not builtin execution.

Initial fixture treated metadata GETs and tool-less auxiliary inference as unexpected. Final fixture rejects metadata locally, gives tool-less auxiliary calls no capabilities, limits inference to six requests per case, and checks all payloads through real router request policy.

additional_validation.assistant_unit_suite: 14 tests passed independently on updated source, including requested-note completion verification.
additional_validation.source_whitespace: git diff --check passed for scoped helper.

boundary_review_refresh.unchanged_frozen_boundary: All previously recorded free_ai router, lifecycle, credential and control source/test hashes still match the prior report.
reviewed_changes: execution_connection type guard rejects non-string inputs cleanly.
TaskStore records explicit existing execution connection for legacy/default tasks without changing request fingerprint construction.
Captured free-cloud Voice turn uses one stable request identity, preventing paraphrased briefs from creating extra tasks.
Assistant workspace selection requires absolute expanded paths.
Managed child environment removes host DBus/display/XDG session variables while retaining its absolute private tool socket.
Requested-note completion verifies persisted receipt identity, actual bytes, size and hash; failure retains model report and interrupts instead of claiming completion.
Artifacts label checked bytes and require review of generated facts.

remaining_gates: Live Groq text/function behavior and free-plan account availability remain untested.
Synthetic answers do not establish model usefulness, factual accuracy, prompt-injection resistance for all inputs or every tool-call variant.
Production router/keyring/lifecycle package integration is separate; facade behavior is not evidence for that process.
No connected account/read-only scope/revocation, full recovery, signed delivery, clean guest, native setup, Lenovo, physical microphone/speaker or performance acceptance is claimed.
Exact changed inputs invalidate affected evidence and require targeted revalidation.
